notes: Qini panel plots every persisted per-seed curve (fracs vs qini); multi-seed learners show all seeds faintly plus the across-seed mean.
Uplift@k and policy-gain panels use DR/IPW bootstrap point estimates with paired Poisson 95% CIs.
Calibration and decile panels average bin statistics across stochastic seeds (seeds 0, 1, 2) per bin_index.
A/B panel bars are constant-policy IPW values with known propensity; annotations use the raw-rate ab_report statistics.
